name: com.knowasiak/knowasiak
title: Knowasiak
description: Find businesses, people and posts in Knowasiak's business community, and read them in full.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Knowasiak, a public network of 14,000+ businesses and business owners, for businesses, people and posts, or (type "help") its help guides on how the site works. Returns ids to read in full with fetch, with a short snippet and the public URL of each.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "packaging design Sydney" or "ISO 9001 composites manufacturer". For help: "how does the feed rank posts".

type.description: What to return. Default: all (profiles and posts).

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one Knowasiak profile, post or help guide in full, as Markdown, by the id from search (e.g. "profile:AdityaGaurav", "post:36405" or "help:discover-people"), or by its knowasiak.com address. A profile includes its links and recent posts; a post its replies.

id.description: An id from search: "profile:<username>", "post:<number>", "help:<slug>" or "page:<slug>"; or a knowasiak.com URL.

tools.name: find_businesses
tools.description: Find businesses on Knowasiak that do something, optionally in a country or city. Use it when someone wants a supplier, agency, service provider or partner.

what.description: What the business does, e.g. "commercial cleaning" or "Shopify development".

where.description: Optional country or city, e.g. "Dubai" or "India".

tools.name: latest_posts
tools.description: The newest public posts on Knowasiak, optionally about a topic.

topic.description: Optional topic, e.g. "ecommerce" or "real estate Dubai".

tools.name: discover_people
tools.description: Knowasiak's Discover: people and businesses worth following, each with why they were picked, plus who follows whom among them. With no arguments on a signed-in connection, the member's own suggestions. Give similar_to (a username) for "Show similar": people like that profile. Give followers_of or following_of for one account's network. Or search by words and filters.

query.description: Words in their name, bio or posts, e.g. "packaging design" or "D2C founder".

industry.description: Industry: software (Software & IT), ecommerce (E-commerce & retail), marketing (Marketing & advertising), consulting (Consulting & services), finance (Finance & fintech), health (Health & wellness), education (Education & training), real_estate (Real estate & construction), manufacturing (Manufacturing & industrial), food (Food & hospitality), travel (Travel & tourism), media (Media & entertainment), creative (Design & creative), logistics (Logistics & transport), energy (Energy & environment), legal (Legal services), nonprofit (Non-profit & community), home_services (Home & local services), beauty (Beauty & personal care), automotive (Automotive), sports (Sports, fitness & recreation), events (Events & weddings), pets (Pets & animals), export_import (Export & import), coaching (Coaching & tuition), textiles (Textiles & garments), agriculture (Agriculture & farming), interiors (Interior design & furniture).

similar_to.description: A username: people like this profile (Show similar).

followers_of.description: A username: the people who follow this account.

following_of.description: A username: the people this account follows.

country.description: Two-letter country code. A Knowasiak Pro filter: used only when the connected member has Pro. For places, people_in_place works for everyone.

tools.name: person_details
tools.description: What Knowasiak's Discover panel says about one profile: a sentence on why they are worth knowing (their industry, how often they post, how many people found their posts useful and where, people in common on a signed-in connection), a few facts, and whether the member follows them. Use fetch for their full profile and posts.

tools.name: people_map
tools.description: The Knowasiak people map: the places with the most members or businesses, at city level (or a country, for members without a city), optionally only those in one industry or here for one reason, with how many each industry and reason has. Members appear at their city, never an exact position; members who hid themselves are not counted.

here_for.description: Only members here for this: learn (Here to learn), connect (Open to meeting people), share (Sharing what they build), market (Following their industry), customers (Looking for customers).

tools.name: people_in_place
tools.description: Members or businesses in one city (or country) on the Knowasiak map, with what they do and what they are here for. On a signed-in connection, people the member follows or who follow them come first.

place.description: A city ("Mumbai", "Austin, US"), a country name, or a place_id from people_map.
